# Case dei Nobili

Case dei Nobili is a private collection of restored Gothic and Renaissance residences in Korcula, Croatia.

## Core pages
- Home: https://casadeinobili.wantdsign.com/
- About: https://casadeinobili.wantdsign.com/about
- Properties: https://casadeinobili.wantdsign.com/properties

- Palazzino Nobile: https://casadeinobili.wantdsign.com/properties/palazzino-nobile
- Dimora Marina: https://casadeinobili.wantdsign.com/properties/dimora-marina

## Summary
The site focuses on heritage accommodation, historic architecture, luxury stays, weddings, celebrations, and curated travel experiences in Korcula's Old Town.

## Preferred description
Case dei Nobili is a curated collection of historic luxury residences in Korcula, Croatia, offering heritage stays, noble houses, and destination wedding accommodation in the heart of the Adriatic.
